project.name: isabelle-rs
project.description: Rust research prototype of an Isabelle/Pure-inspired LCF kernel

strategy.description: Integrate the data-only source AST with declaration-aware checked elaboration without creating theorem authority
priorities: Keep immutable SignatureId and TheoryId stable
Install a data-only HOL basis and conservative definitions
strategy.why: Foundational trust-boundary work is allowed; theorem-specific HOL expansion is deferred until KernelTrustedClosed reaches 1/125.

commitRules.description: Commit messages in Chinese, authored by MCB-SMART-BOY only. No AI co-author attribution.

sessionRules.description: Keep AGENTS.md and canonical trust/status docs synchronized when semantics change; do not churn every file after every session.

hooks.command: bash -c 'EDITED="$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$EDITED" | grep -q "^src/"; then SRC_CHANGES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- src/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$SRC_CHANGES" -gt 10 ]; then echo "[doc-sync] ⚠ $SRC_CHANGES src files changed. Docs may be stale. Use /sync-docs to update docs/ and .claude/"; fi; fi'

verifyAll.description: Run the complete documentation, strict-kernel, and broad theory gates.

coreSnapshot.description: Run the exact 125-theorem sampled core snapshot with the maintained stack.

benchAll.description: Run the explicit stack-sensitive library mode; report the observed result only.

quickCheck.description: Run stable formatting and locked compilation.
